title: Introduce cross-SDK 'credential-junction' and harmonize idempotent stream retry presets
author: Maya Chen
body: Motivation: Teams observed intermittent stream resets and duplicate reauth attempts when requests cross language SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) during high load and transient auth failures. This PR introduces a small compatibility layer (credential-junction) and a shared idempotent-retry preset that SDKs can opt into to reduce flapping and make stream ergonomics consistent across languages. Changes: 1) Add a language-agnostic specification for the credential-junction (short-lived lease + soft-reauth hint) and implement thin adapters in the three SDKs. 2) Unify default retry windows and idempotent-stream presets so the client-side retry timing matches server-side lease jitter expectations. 3) Add ergonomic helpers: Python context manager `session_stitch`, TypeScript helper `withSessionLease`, Go `SessionFactory` constructor overload. 4) Bump SDK versions: python -> 2.3.0, typescript -> 1.14.0, go -> 1.8.1. 5) Add tests (unit + e2e connector smoke) and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: credential-junction is opt-in; existing code paths unchanged by default. Rollout plan: feature flagged for 2 weeks in staging, then enabled for blue/green canary customers. Related work: ENG-1423 (auth resilience), ENG-1478 (stream ergonomics), PM-99 (SDK parity).
commits: spec: credential-junction RFC and timing matrices
python: add session_stitch contextmanager and adapter tests
typescript: add withSessionLease helper and typings, bump version
go: add SessionFactory overload and lightweight adapter, bump version
ci: add cross-sdk e2e smoke job and flaky test jitter tolerance
review_comments: Arjun: Please clarifiy how the lease TTL interacts with existing heartbeat windows. Answer: lease TTL is advisory for SDKs; the credential-junction exposes a soft-reauth hint and the SDK uses the shared retry window to avoid aggressive reauth during jitter.
Lucía: Typings look good but add a short migration example in the TS README. Author: added migration snippet and CI verifies the example builds.
Samir: Flaky python test on first run (timezone-depends). Author: fixed test to use fixed timezone and retriggered CI; subsequent run passed.
release_notes: Adds opt-in credential-junction adapter across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs that harmonizes client-side lease handling and idempotent stream retry presets. SDK bumps: python 2.3.0, typescript 1.14.0, go 1.8.1. No breaking changes by default; opt-in migration documented.
